# Bedrock Roof

> Bedrock Roof is a free referral service that connects homeowners and commercial property owners, property managers and HOAs anywhere in the United States with independent local roofing contractors for a free roof inspection and written quote. It is free for homeowners; contractors may pay for introductions. Bedrock Roof is not a roofing contractor and does not perform or warranty roofing work.

Homeowners can request a free quote at https://bedrockroof.com/get-quotes/ for roof replacement, roof repair or leaks, storm damage, or a roof inspection.

- [How much does roof repair cost?](https://bedrockroof.com/roof-repair-cost/): Prices by repair type, roof material and damage size.

## City pages
Each city page (for example https://bedrockroof.com/roofers/houston-tx/) gives a short quick answer, the city's main roof risks, recommended roofing materials, the best time of year for roof work, the state's roofer licensing rules, and local notes. Sources: GeoNames (population), Koppen-Geiger (climate), U.S. Census (county).
